name: Moody Night 3D
description: Low-poly 3D on a highway at blue dusk: lane lines, guard rails, warm street lamps with light pools, cars with headlight glow and traffic driving into the fog, one warm key light with a single soft shadow. A low chase camera rises and glides over the road. Tense what-if stories. No emoji.
prompt_hint: 6-10 scenes (3-5 s). Each: title.kicker + title.main, visual.type "scene3d" with 1-2 objects: car (model car-sedan, car-sedan-sports, car-suv, car-taxi, car-truck), character, stat. set "city" for a street. No emoji.
